Marta Gomez: Quick sync — proposing a foldable left rail + small breadcrumb behavior changes. Screenshot and rough flow in the thread. TL;DR: allow fold state, announce collapse to SR users, preserve shareable routes. https://img.redwood.design/leftrail-v2.png DesignBot: Screenshot uploaded: leftrail-v2.png CJ Park: I like the idea of a foldable rail for density, but worried about discoverability and keyboard discoverability. How will people know it exists? Marta Gomez: Good call — thinking we keep a persistent hamburger for show/hide and an always-available tooltip on first-run. Also an aria hint on focus. Lee Nguyen: On focus order: if we collapse, ensure the first tabbable item is the hamburger toggle. Also implement `aria-expanded` on the button and an `aria-live` polite announcer when the state changes. Example: `` and `
Navigation collapsed
` Dena Patel: Copy nits for breadcrumbs: when collapsed we should shorten crumb labels (e.g., "Model versions" -> "Versions") and show full label on hover / title attr. Avoid truncating mid-word. Samir Rao: Routing question: do we persist fold state in URL or user settings? If someone shares a link, should it open with rail collapsed? Storing in pathname feels noisy. Maybe a query param `?rail=collapsed` for share links and default to user pref/localStorage for normal usage. CJ Park: Query param approach is OK. But if we use `?rail=collapsed` make sure it doesn't create duplicate history entries during toggles — use `history.replaceState` not push. Marta Gomez: Agreed. Proposal: primary storage = per-user preference (localStorage), overrideable by a single query param `rail=compact|expanded`, resolved on route load. We'll add `replaceState` on toggle to avoid flooding back button. Lee Nguyen: Accessibility details: screen reader announcement should be descriptive but brief. Proposed text: "Navigation collapsed. Press Alt+M to open navigation." (we'll pick actual shortcut later). Also include a 250ms debounce to avoid repeated announcements when animations run. Dena Patel: Breadcrumb behaviour: when rail collapsed, collapse separators and show caret only for last 2 levels to save space. Also update copy in designs doc v2: replace "Projects / Models / Versions" -> "Projects › Models › Versions" (use › for compactness). Samir Rao: Telemetry: emit `nav.toggle` with {source: 'user', method: 'keyboard|mouse', resultingState: 'collapsed|expanded', route: window.location.pathname}. Also emit `nav.pref_set` when user toggles "remember my preference". Marta Gomez: Implementation owners: Lee -> front-end interactions (toggle, aria-live, replaceState change), Dena -> microcopy & breadcrumb label rules, Samir -> routing/telemetry. I'll add a short scoping doc in product. CJ Park: One more: keyboard shortcut choice should not conflict with browser or OS. Maybe Ctrl+` or Alt+M is fine but run through accessibility QA. DesignBot: New Google doc created: "left-rail-folding-spec" (shared with @design, @eng). Dena Patel: tiny design tweak: when rail is collapsed hover should show an expanded tooltip list (delay 350ms) instead of full persistent expansion — avoids accidental opens. Lee Nguyen: Implementation note: tooltips on hover + focus, but also support persistent open on toggle. For mobile, rail always collapsed into bottom sheet. Samir Rao: For share links we should canonicalize URLs: if `?rail=collapsed` present, add it to share card generation. Otherwise omit. Marta Gomez: Decision check — does everyone agree? If yes I'll move to PRD and schedule a 2-sprint work block. CJ Park: +1 :thumbsup: Dena Patel: +1 :thumbsup: Lee Nguyen: +1 :rocket: Samir Rao: +1 Marta Gomez: Great — moving to PRD. I'll assign tickets and link implementation issues here when created.
